This PR, which you wrote, adds an Export CSV button on the reports page that downloads every table column as a CSV file, reading 100 rows at a time and stopping at a 4-second deadline. It delivers the button, every table column, and the bound that keeps an export under 5 seconds, while the spec defers emailed exports and audit-log events to acme/widgets#46.

Nothing blocks merging, and the test check passed in CI on the commit being reviewed. One smaller point does not block merging: the export reads rows with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper in lib/page.ts (src/api/export.ts:31), and fix nits can take it. After merging, the PR asks you to publish the guide and the spec asks you to tag the release; the repository documents a script for each, and both are offered after the merge. You cannot approve your own PR, so approve is not offered.
